article.title: Relevancy of statement as to fact of public nature contained in certain Acts or notifications
article.content: When the Court has to form an opinion as to the existence of any fact of a public nature, any statement of it, made in a recital contained in any Central Act or State Act or in a Central Government or State Government notification appearing in the respective Official Gazette or in any printed paper or in electronic or digital form purporting to be such Gazette, is a relevant fact.
article.html:
31Relevancy of statement as to fact of public nature contained in certain Acts or notifications

Section 31 · Part II · Chapter II · Statements made under special circumstances

When the Court has to form an opinion as to the existence of any fact of a public nature, any statement of it, made in a recital contained in any Central Act or State Act or in a Central Government or State Government notification appearing in the respective Official Gazette or in any printed paper or in electronic or digital form purporting to be such Gazette, is a relevant fact.
